{{Top|leg}}
'''Blue Squadron''' was a fighter squadron consisting of three [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] used by [[Mugaari pirates]]. The fighter squadron was present at the [[Battle of the Tungra sector|Battle]] of the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]] where they were destroyed attempted to stop [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces from destroying a [[Mugaari cargo loading area|cargo loading area]] that was making an arms deal with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the pirates. The arms deal was completely destroyed in the process.
